extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.11.5 - Seasons default to Seasons Info v2 in Arctic Zephyr Stremio; episode info panels from season browsing show Bridge actions. v0.11.4 - Setup wizard syncs MDBList after saving an API key and reloads the skin when it completes. v0.11.3 - Setup wizard: add your streams and metadata addons and MDBList key step by step (Settings, or the skin's ... menu). v0.11.2 - Arctic Zephyr Stremio support: skin helpers, hubs, Cinemeta and streaming-service lists, its own context menu and info page buttons; Kodi's info page replaces Extended info and library integration is off. Kodi's Mark as watched updates your history. Continue Watching pages 20 at a time. v0.11.1 - Faster Continue Watching and Next Up (results reused until you watch something); smaller, compressed cache capped at 25 MB. v0.11.0 - New stream page: cards with badges, filter chips, no logos. Extended info for episodes. Selecting can open Extended info for episodes too. Fixed context menu entries overwriting each other, and settings buttons on Fire TV. v0.10.3 - With autoplay on: "Show Playable Streams" in context menus and a Streams tile in Extended info. Removing an episode from Continue Watching also removes its show from Next Up until you watch more. v0.10.2 - Continue Watching shows descriptions, cast and details.
